# QA Plan: Sprint 9 (Interface and Audio, final sprint)
**Date**: 2026-10-17
**Generated by**: /qa-plan sprint
**Scope**: 17 stories across 2 systems (Interface 10, Audio 7): IF-001 to IF-012 (minus IF-009 and IF-011, Complete) and AU-001 to AU-007
**Engine**: React 19.2.8 + Vite 6.4.3 + @react-three/fiber 9.6.1 / three.js 0.185.1
**Sprint File**: `production/sprints/sprint-009.md`
**qa.level**: standard

Method: story list from `production/sprint-status.yaml` (17, matching the plan's tables); headers and acceptance criteria by grep; GDD `design/gdd/interface.md` and `design/gdd/audio.md` Formulas and Edge Cases; `docs/architecture/control-manifest.md` Presentation Layer Rules; `docs/click-through.md`. I listed `src/` files and test files by name but did **not** read their contents or run the suite, so "existing" below means a file with this subject exists, not that it meets the AC. `/story-readiness` re-checks each. Types are as declared (none inferred).

**Test rules for this sprint** (retro 7 and 8):
- Expected values are GDD or living-spec literals (0.90/1.00/1.10/1.25, 3 s, 400 kg, 4,080 CR / 24h, master × channel), never the module's own constant. Each Logic and Integration story records one mutation check in its Completion Notes.
- UI and Visual/Feel evidence is captured by Claude with Headless Playwright at exactly 1280×720 (`npx playwright-cli`; the in-app pane tops out at 800×600). Never the user's Chrome. Evidence goes in `production/qa/evidence/<story-slug>/`. TM-015's first evidence was 800×600 and failed review; state this rule in every `/dev-story` brief.
- Claude cannot listen. AU-002, AU-004 and AU-007 (and the listening halves of AU-001 and AU-003) need the user to listen. Claude records settings, scenarios and automated results; the user listens and signs off. Plan these together near the end of the sprint.

**Findings at planning:**
1. **Five stories are under their criteria minimum** (IF-008, AU-001, AU-003, AU-005 at 2 of 3; AU-006 at 1 of 3). Sprint task R-2 adds them before the run. The extra checks proposed under each story below (staged-gain literals, bed/overlay behaviour, drop-not-queue, RNG draw count, real-time arming window) come from the GDD Formulas and Edge Cases; R-2 added one criterion each to IF-008, AU-001, AU-003 and AU-005 and two to AU-006 on 2026-10-17, so all five now meet the minimum.
2. **AU-005 may need a source change.** Its own text says the criteria are verification requirements, not a claim the current lazy bridge passes. Size it at readiness.
3. **IF-001 gates six stories** and is 36 captures plus a click-through record. Script the sweep once.
4. **IF-005 AC19 is one compound criterion** with many fixtures (pointer, Enter, Space, Timeline keys, focus trap). Run each as its own case. I did not verify that the suite has a DOM test environment; if it does not, these run as a headless Playwright script and the transcript is the evidence.
5. **IF-003 AC5 and IF-007 AC10 compare data Tactical owns** (TM-007, TM-015, both Complete). Interface verifies display, not computation.
6. **GDD OQ3 (gunfire vs Devices) touches no story here.** R-6 decides it by 2026-10-28.
7. **Audio README is the owner of the late-load window and overlap caps.** Tests read them from there; do not copy the integers into tests.

## Automated Tests and Verification (per story)

#### IF-001 — Every surface fits 1280×720 at every text scale (UI)
**Automated (where a seam exists)**:
- `src/state/settingsStore.test.ts`: the text-scale step set is exactly {0.90, 1.00, 1.10, 1.25} (literals, not the module constant)
- A scripted sweep (kept with the evidence, `production/qa/evidence/if-001/sweep.mjs`): for each of 9 surfaces × 4 scales, assert no element's `scrollWidth > clientWidth` clip and no bounding-box intersection outside the declared overlays (Settings, Balance, pause, toasts); print the failures per surface
**Verification**: Headless capture at 1280×720; evidence in `production/qa/evidence/if-001/`; sign-off: qa-lead
**Checklist**:
- [ ] 36 retained screenshots (Menu, World Network, Research, Brief, Assembly, Mission HUD, pause, Debrief, Settings × 90/100/110/125%)
- [ ] One sub-minimum capture (1100×650) of one surface showing scroll, not compression
- [ ] Click-through record per `docs/click-through.md`, 1280×720, naming every unexercised screen or interaction (AC20); Mission HUD, pause and Debrief may use labelled fixtures from `docs/mission-playbook.md`
**Edge cases**: Viewport below 1280×720 (e.g. 1100×650): layout scrolls, panels are not compressed; 125% scale on the densest surface (Assembly, Debrief): overflow reachable by scroll; Overlay on overlay (pause + Settings, toasts + pause): the only allowed intersections

#### IF-008 — Pause modal and two-step Abort (Integration)
**Automated**:

**Mutation check**: shorten the arming window to 1 s → the timeout test fails
**Manual**: Screenshots: pause open, Abort armed, Abort after timeout (still paused)

#### AU-001 — Mixer: master, channels, mute, and settings persistence (Integration)
**Automated**:
- `src/game/audio.test.ts`, `src/state/settingsStore.test.ts`: `staged_gain = 0 if muted else master × channel` with literals: master 0.5 × combat 0.8 → 0.4; mute → 0; unmute restores 0.4
- Each channel control changes only its own bus factor and no other stored level; master scales all four buses once
- Reload round trip: nondefault master, four channels and mute match; after New Operation and a second reload they still match (settings slot, not campaign)
- Exactly four buses (ui, combat, music, ambience); no fifth
**Edge cases**: Silencing combat while keeping UI is valid; the authored hierarchy is not enforced over player overrides; Master/mute applied once at the master stage, not copied to every channel node
**Mutation check**: apply master twice → the 0.4 case fails (0.2)
**Manual**: Listening pass in Settings with a source on each bus (the user listens; `docs/click-through.md` Audio changes step 1)

#### AU-003 — Strategy bed and mission city-hum lifetimes (Integration)
**Automated**:
- `src/ui/strategyAudio.test.ts`, `src/game/audio.beds.test.ts`: World Network → Research → Brief → Assembly keeps the same strategy source (no restart); entering Menu, Mission or Debrief stops it and discards an in-flight decode
- Mission bed start picks exactly one of the 3 committed city-hum clips; `pickMissionBedUrl` takes no arguments (not keyed to contract, district, hour, weather or Threat); it stops on leave
- Leaving the mission (Abort, result → Debrief, unmount) while the bed is loading: the late load never starts it
- Pause, Settings and Balance overlays neither mute nor swap beds, and do not change `Phase`
**Edge cases**: Two deploys of one contract may pick different clips; Overlays are not Phase changes
**Mutation check**: restart the bed on each Screen change → the same-source test fails
**Manual**: Listening check of bed continuity across the four Screens (user)

#### AU-004 — Rain follows live weather; Alert tension drone (Visual/Feel)
**Automated (where a seam exists)**:
- `src/game/audio.beds.test.ts` (advisory, mocked graph): weather none → no rain source; light and heavy → the matching recording; adjacent change crossfades; leaving while rain loads does not restart it
- Alert 0 → drone silent; rises to 1–3 → drone ramps on the combat bus; mission end → released; a rise during the release tail does not stack a second layer
**Verification**: evidence in `production/qa/evidence/au-004/`; sign-off: audio-director (lead sign-off)
**Checklist**:
- [ ] Listening-evidence note in `production/qa/evidence/au-004/`: a full rain loop for each of none, light, heavy; a scripted front (Glass Veil 22:16:38) for clicks or gaps; Alert 0 → 3 → end (the user listens; Claude records settings and scenarios)
**Edge cases**: Dry mission mounts no rain hiss; Audio follows live weather, not the Brief's; Reduced motion drops visual rain only, not audio; Drone follows HUD Alert (living CorpSec in Combat), not Threat

#### AU-005 — Unavailable and late audio never block play or burst (Integration)
**Automated**:
- `src/game/audio.test.ts`: audio unavailable or context not running → one-shots dropped, not queued, play not blocked, nothing plays later as a burst
- Deferred UI or combat clip decode completing after the freshness window (read the value from the audio README; do not copy the integer) → no source start, even for a single stale cue; observe source-start calls
- A fresh event after successful decode and after the rate gate clears still plays; decode rejected → no source start and play stays usable
- UI module load deferred so the originating click is stale on arrival → not replayed as a fresh click; record module-load and decode evidence separately
**Edge cases**: Overlap cap or rate limit hit → drop the new one-shot (gunfire leaves room for impacts and warnings); The AC says it is a verification requirement, not a claim the current lazy bridge passes: expect a possible source change; `sound.ts` must not typecheck-import `game/audio.ts`
**Mutation check**: drop the freshness check → the stale-cue test fails
**Manual**: Smoke: cold-cache play with the console open; console inspection is diagnostics, not proof of cue admission

#### AU-006 — Presentation-only randomness does not change outcomes (Logic)
**Automated**:
- `src/game/audio.beds.test.ts` or `src/game/world.test.ts`: two controlled runs with identical seed, snapshots, difficulty, variant, loadout, commands, command timing and timestep schedule, varying only the mission-bed pick and gunshot rate jitter → hit/outcome state, weather script and Opening hour match at equal simulation steps
- The sim's `rng()` draw count is unchanged by a bed pick or by jitter (neither consumes the sim stream)
**Edge cases**: Two independently played deploys are not equivalent fixtures; Jitter keeps weapon identity and cadence; Two uncontrolled random draws are not required to differ
**Mutation check**: make the bed pick draw from the sim RNG → the equal-outcome test fails

#### AU-007 — No celebration sting, spoken VO, or spatial shooter mix (Visual/Feel)
**Automated (where a seam exists)**:
- Mocked-context test (advisory, if a seam exists): entering Debrief, including quiet replay, requests no sting; arming Abort requests no mission-end sting
- Smoke grep (not a suite test): no `PannerNode`, `StereoPannerNode`, `THREE.Audio`, `PositionalAudio` or `AudioListener` under `src/` (control manifest Never list)
**Verification**: evidence in `production/qa/evidence/au-007/`; sign-off: audio-director (lead sign-off)
**Checklist**:
- [ ] Listening-evidence note in `production/qa/evidence/au-007/`: Debrief (win, loss, quiet replay) and Abort-armed pause; listen for any VO or panned shooter mix (the user listens)
**Edge cases**: Quiet replay Debrief stays paperwork-quiet; Abort confirm stops the mission bed as on any leave; Spoken VO or spatial audio is out of scope unless §18 reopens

## Smoke Test Scope

Critical paths to verify before QA hand-off (`/smoke-check sprint`). Labelled fixtures are allowed where the plan names them; say so in the record.

1. App loads to the Menu without a console error; New Operation and Continue both work (IF-006).
2. Every visited screen at 1280×720 shows no clipping at text scale 100% and 125% (IF-001).
3. Select a contract, Brief, Assembly, deploy a valid squad; Deploy with no contract is refused (IF-003, IF-012).
4. Research: Authorize a project by keyboard; focus returns after Settings from pause (IF-005, IF-008).
5. In a mission: minimap, weather chip after the Glass Veil front, a tutorial toast, pause, Abort arm and timeout (IF-007, IF-008).
6. Debrief: invoice reads unfiled, then filed after return to World Network (IF-010).
7. Audio: mute/unmute restores levels; strategy bed continues across the four Screens; rain follows weather; no sting at Debrief (AU-001, 003, 004, 007). Cold-cache play with the console open shows no burst (AU-005).
8. Save/load: reload keeps Settings including the four audio levels and mute.
9. Frame check inside a mission: p95 at most 9.0 ms, max at most 25.0 ms, 0 frames over 50 ms (Sprint 7 item 8 and Sprint 8 item 9 numbers; closes R-3 if it repeats).

| AU-007 | No celebration sting, VO or spatial panning in Debrief or Abort-armed pause? | 1 | The user (listens) |

## Definition of Done — This Sprint

A story is DONE when ALL of the following are true:

- [ ] All acceptance criteria verified — by automated result or documented manual evidence with sign-off
- [ ] Test file exists at the specified path for all Logic and Integration stories (AU-001, 003, 005, 006, IF-008)
- [ ] Each Logic/Integration story records one mutation check (break the source, watch the test fail, restore)
- [ ] Retained 1280×720 screenshots in `production/qa/evidence/<story-slug>/` for all UI and Visual/Feel stories (IF-001 to 007, 010, 012, AU-002, 004, 007)
- [ ] Signed-off evidence doc for all Visual/Feel stories (IF-002, AU-002, 004, 007)
- [ ] Smoke check passes (`/smoke-check sprint`)
- [ ] No regressions introduced (full suite green, `npm run build`, lint)
- [ ] Code reviewed with specialists (not NOT ASSESSED without a written waiver)
- [ ] Story file updated to `Status: Complete` (via `/story-done`)
